note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Trump is pushing a massive AI buildout. His own voters are wary of what comes with it
items.blurb: A CNBC survey finds 63% of voters oppose a data center near home, pushing midterm candidates toward utility-cost safeguards.

items.title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
items.blurb: CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN, cash-burning neoclouds Nvidia backs, are down at least 30% this month as credit tightens.

items.title: AI funding fears rattle Wall Street. Here's how we're adjusting our portfolio
items.blurb: Meta's first negative free cash flow since its IPO deepened investor worry over how the AI buildout gets financed.

items.title: Washington's message to AI execs: please shut up
items.blurb: Lawmakers and White House advisers say AI leaders' talk of sentience and catastrophe is becoming a political liability.

items.title: Axios ahead: 2028 and beyond
items.blurb: Axios outlines AI-driven bets for local journalism, including a system that tracks government action.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: AI spending fears haunt markets before Halloween
items.blurb: Renewed worry over AI companies' spending drove a broad U.S. sell-off, testing investor faith in the buildout.

items.title: On the ground at Nvidia's AI showpiece: Jensen-mania, robot ducks and neocloud distress
items.blurb: Nvidia's Berlin conference closed as CoreWeave fell 10% and Nebius 7%, showing strain among GPU-rental clouds.

items.title: Wall Street prepares for AI's "day after"
items.blurb: Large U.S. banks are now scenario-planning for an AI-driven catastrophe, alongside the AI labs themselves.

items.title: AI's 'Black October': Critical PHP flaws set off global security scramble
items.blurb: Governments and businesses race to contain AI-discovered PHP flaws after details leaked online; PHP runs most of the web.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield drops back to 5% this week as investors seek cover from AI worries
items.blurb: AI-driven tech selling pushed investors into government bonds, a sign of doubt about debt-funded AI buildouts.

items.title: American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce to 'prepare for AI'
items.blurb: American Express is taking a $336 million restructuring charge as it trims staff ahead of wider AI use.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Tech falls to earth, Musk's fortunes diverge
items.blurb: The Nasdaq fell 2.6%, its worst day since early July, on renewed doubts about AI spending.

items.title: AI agents could disrupt bank deposits. Why Wall Street may be overreacting
items.blurb: Agents that shop for better yields threaten banks' sticky deposits, weighing on financial stocks.

items.title: Turmoil hits AI buildout as neoclouds face pressure, credit risks mount and Solidigm pulls IPO
items.blurb: Neocloud stocks fell hardest this week as credit-default-swap spreads on Meta, Oracle and Nvidia bonds hit record highs.

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang visits Kazakhstan, the next AI hub?
items.blurb: Huang said Kazakhstan's energy and data-center plans could make it a major computing hub serving Europe.

items.title: AI economic research is getting really good
items.blurb: AI tools now handle much of the work economists produce, from academia and think tanks to government agencies.

items.title: Exclusive: Meta acquires AI data platform Sundial
items.blurb: Meta bought Sundial, an AI-powered data analytics platform founded by two former Meta employees.

items.title: Critical web security flaws spark global alarm as Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond
items.blurb: Two critical PHP flaws allow remote code execution; Google used Gemini to assess attacks and verify patches.

items.title: Asia's hottest data center market aims to quell concerns over water and power use
items.blurb: Amazon and Google's $15 billion Indian data center projects face local backlash as India drafts a national policy.

items.title: Barclays to slash 5,000 jobs in AI efficiency push
items.blurb: The British bank will cut about 5% of staff, mostly support roles, citing efficiency gains driven by AI.

items.title: Why governments pulled websites offline over the decades-old PHP programming language
items.blurb: AI-assisted researchers found flaws in PHP, which runs most websites; patches shipped early as governments took sites offline.

items.title: AI stocks tumble as the defensives rise. What it says about this uneasy market
items.blurb: AI stocks fell after Nvidia's Jensen Huang described a capital shortage for neocloud compute providers despite heavy demand.

items.title: Black October: why bugs discovered by OpenAI tech are creating a cyber emergency
items.blurb: Critical PHP flaws found with OpenAI models forced emergency patches and site shutdowns, testing how defenders handle AI-found bugs.

items.title: OpenAI nears up to $30 billion funding round at $1.25 trillion valuation led by UAE investors
items.blurb: The round, led by UAE investors alongside Coatue, is meant to bridge OpenAI to a planned 2027 IPO.
